description: hERG cardiotoxicity risk heuristic (Veith 2009). 4-rule shortcut: MW>400, logP>3.5, TPSA<75, basic N. Higher = more risk.
note: metrics_v2 herg_cardio_risk is independent of the existing by_metric/herg_cardio_risk.json which uses the anticancer_metric_suite.py implementation (TODO-15 P0 metric). Both are MEASURED but use different heuristics.
